# SYNTHETIC STRUCTURAL FIXTURES ONLY

All values are invented; actual uploads stay outside Git. CSV headings, OLE XLS
sheet/header shape and XLSX Germany/with-tax/diesel columns reflect inspected native
layouts. Familiar provider identifiers are structural test expectations, not evidence
these fixture values were obtained from providers. Missing flags remain unknown.
The fixture copyright notice is explicitly synthetic and grants no source rights.

The small XLS was created once using **xlwt==1.3.0**, an isolated fixture-authoring
tool, not a runtime/CI dependency. Parsing uses existing pinned **xlrd==2.0.2**;
XLSX uses existing pinned **openpyxl==3.1.5**. No dependency lock change is needed.
